title: Delhi protest: Neha Bora to explain rejection of peace bond by Dec 10

ai.summary: Delhi residents protested at India Gate in November 2025 demanding lasting action on toxic air, but police said the site was not a permitted venue and a second protest ended in over 20 arrests and serious charges.
